agreements.title: Agreement templates
agreements.description: The rental terms your renters sign. A booking uses the template picked for it, or the default.
agreements.defaultHint: Used for a booking when no other template is picked
agreements.legalNote: The starter template is a general starting point, not legal advice. Have a lawyer review your terms before renters sign them.

ownerOnly.title: Only the owner can change agreement templates
ownerOnly.description: Ask the account owner to add or edit the terms renters sign.

confirmDelete.title: Delete “{{name}}”?
confirmDelete.description:
Agreements already issued with this template keep their text.

Bookings set to use it will use the default template instead.

editor.description: Changes apply to agreements issued from now on. Agreements already issued keep the text they were issued with.
editor.name: Template name
editor.nameHelp: Shown to your team when they pick the terms for a booking.
editor.bodyHelp: Leave a blank line between paragraphs. Start a line with # and a space to make it a section heading. The renter, vehicle, dates and charges are added above your terms automatically.

notFound.title: Template not found
notFound.description: It may have been deleted. Go back to the list to pick another.

signatory.title: Company signature
signatory.description: Who signs rental agreements for your company. It is put on every agreement as it is issued, so the renter signs one you have already signed.
signatory.unset: Until you set one, each agreement is signed for your company in the typed name of the team member who issues it.
signatory.name: Signatory name
signatory.typeInstead: Sign with the typed name instead of a drawn signature
signatory.typedNote: The typed name will appear as the signature.

sign.heading: Sign the agreement
sign.consent: I have read this rental agreement and agree to be bound by it, and I agree to sign it electronically.
sign.consentRequired: Tick the box to confirm you agree before signing.
sign.name: Full name
sign.namePlaceholder: As it appears on your licence
sign.draw: Draw your signature in the box
sign.typeInstead: Use my typed name as my signature instead
sign.typedNote: Your typed name will be recorded as your signature.
sign.signatureRequired: Draw your signature, or choose to use your typed name.
sign.signatureUnreadable: We couldn't read that signature. Clear it and try again.
sign.failed: We couldn't record the signature. Please try again.

link.title: Send the agreement for signature
link.description: {{name}} reads and signs it on their own phone or computer.
link.subject: {{company}}: your rental agreement for booking {{reference}}
link.message: Hi {{name}}, please read and sign the rental agreement for booking {{reference}} before pickup: {{url}}
link.copyDescription: {{name}} can open and download the signed agreement from this link.
link.copySubject: {{company}}: your signed rental agreement for booking {{reference}}
link.copyMessage: Hi {{name}}, here is your signed rental agreement for booking {{reference}}: {{url}}

counter.title: Sign at the counter
counter.description: Hand the device to {{name}} to read and sign. It is recorded as signed in front of you.

void.title: Void this agreement?
void.signedDescription: The booking goes back to unsigned and pickup waits for a new agreement. The renter's link stops working.
void.unsignedDescription: The renter's link stops working. A new agreement is issued the next time it is sent or signed.
void.reasonRequired: Say why it is being voided.

template.title: Change the terms
template.description: Pick the template this booking's agreement uses. An agreement already sent is replaced, and its link stops working.
template.label: Template

reasons.not_before_pickup: The vehicle has already been picked up.
reasons.not_issued: No agreement has been issued yet.
reasons.not_confirmed: The agreement can be sent once the reservation is confirmed.

page.title: Rental agreement
page.greeting: Hi {{name}}, please read the agreement below and sign at the end.
page.secure: Your signature is recorded with the date, time and device.

signed.title: Agreement signed
signed.body: Signed by {{name}} on {{date}}. Keep a copy for your records.

replaced.title: This agreement was replaced
replaced.body: {{company}} issued a newer agreement for booking {{reference}}. Ask them for the new link.

closed.title: This agreement can no longer be signed
closed.body: Booking {{reference}} is not waiting for a signature any more. Contact {{company}} if you think this is a mistake.

invalid.title: This link is not valid
invalid.body: Check the link you were sent, or ask the rental company for a new one.

unreachable.title: We couldn't load your agreement
unreachable.body: Check your connection and try again.
